newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market slack as fixtures, orders few.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market slack as fixtures, orders few.

text.p: Business was muted at the start of the week on London's sugar freight market with only a handful of enquiries and fixtures emerging, shipbrokers said on Monday.
E D & F Man quoted for 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Rio de Janeiro to Baltic or Black Sea for mid-August and a further 10,300 tonnes in bulk from Beira to US Gulf/Atlantic, also for mid-August.
South Africa Sugar Association was in the market for 18,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Durban to Japan for August 16/20 August.
Shipbrokers said Belize Sugar Industries quoted for 7,000 tonnes in bulk from Belize to Nantes.
Of the day's firmer business, Man was said to have fixed a 25,000-tonne bulk cargo from Paranagua to Baltic or Black Sea for July/August dates.
CSR fixed 20,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Queensland to Surabaya for August 5/15 at a rate reported to be $17.
